parameters.help_en:
The email header settings.

Both standard and non-standard fields must comply with the syntax requirements for headers in the standard. You can pass up to 10 headers through the headers field when sending emails by calling API operations. Headers that exceed the limit are ignored. SMTP has no such limit.

Standard fields

Message-ID, List-Unsubscribe, and List-Unsubscribe-Post.

Standard fields overwrite the original values in the email headers.

Non-standard fields

Case-insensitive.

a. Start with X-User- (not pushed to EventBridge or Message Service. Required only for API operations. SMTP allows any custom fields).

b. Start with X-User-Notify- (pushed to EventBridge and Message Service. Supported by both API operations and SMTP).

When pushed to EventBridge or Message Service, the header field includes these fields
parameters.help_zh:
邮件头设置

标准字段和非标准字段都需要符合标准中对头的语法要求，API 发信最多可通过 headers 字段传入 10 个标头，超出限制会被忽略，SMTP 没有限制。

1、标准字段

Message-ID，List-Unsubscribe，List-Unsubscribe-Post

标准字段会覆盖掉邮件头中原有的值。

2、非标准字段

不区分大小写

a、以 X-User- 开头（不推送到事件总线EB、消息服务MNS。仅API要求，SMTP任意自定义）

b、以 X-User-Notify- 开头（推送到事件总线EB、消息服务MNS。API和SMTP都支持）


推动到EB或MNS时，header字段下会包含这些字段
parameters.name: headers

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable domain-level authentication. Valid values:

true

false

This parameter is used only for domain-level authentication. Ignore this parameter for sender address-level authentication.

Create the address domain-auth-created-by-system@example.com in the console. Keep the prefix before @ fixed and use your own domain name as the suffix.

2.

API scenario

Set AccountName to the domain name. The recipient sees domain-auth-created-by-system@example.com as the sender.

SMTP scenario

a. Set the domain name password by calling the ModifyPWByDomain operation.

b. Authenticate by using the domain name and the configured password. Pass a custom address, such as user@example.com, as the actual sender in the mailfrom field. The recipient sees user@example.com as the sender
parameters.help_zh:
启用域级别认证

true

false

仅在域级别认证时使用，发信地址级别认证请忽略。

1、domain-auth-created-by-system@example.com 控制台创建这个地址，@前缀保持固定不变，后缀用自己域名。

2、

API场景

AccountName填域名，收件人看到的发件人是domain-auth-created-by-system@example.com。

SMTP场景

a.通过 ModifyPWByDomain 接口设置域名密码。

b.使用域名和设置的密码认证，真实发件人mailfrom传自定义的地址，如user@example.com，收件人看到的发件人是user@example.com
parameters.name: domain_auth
